name: Resend
description: Typed bounded Resend email delivery, scheduling, received email metadata, domains, contacts, segments, audiences, topics, templates and API key administration.

permissions.description: One fixed Resend HTTPS API request using an external API key. Writes/sends require operation-specific confirmation; no retries, downloads, ambient credentials, listeners or filesystem. API-key creation omitted because a durable secret sink is unavailable.

definitions.name: Resend Trigger up to 100 batch emails at once.
definitions.description: Resend Trigger up to 100 batch emails at once.
definitions.documentation: POST /emails/batch. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="RESEND EMAILS/SEND-BATCH". Only fixed https://api.resend.com. RuntimeConnection has config and credentials.apiKey (accessToken fallback); builtin config.$connection selects it, or RESEND_API_KEY/apiKeySecret supplies a named secret. No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Status code only; no private response text in errors. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. No downloads, SMTP, React rendering, listeners, webhook registration, token refresh or API-key creation (no supported secret sink). Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction and official OpenAPI 1.5.1.

definitions.documentation: GET /emails/{email_id}/attachments. Only fixed https://api.resend.com. RuntimeConnection has config and credentials.apiKey (accessToken fallback); builtin config.$connection selects it, or RESEND_API_KEY/apiKeySecret supplies a named secret. No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. No downloads, SMTP, React rendering, listeners, webhook registration, token refresh or API-key creation (no supported secret sink). definitions.description: Resend Retrieve a list of received emails
definitions.documentation: GET /emails/receiving. Only fixed https://api.resend.com. RuntimeConnection has config and credentials.apiKey (accessToken fallback); builtin config.$connection selects it, or RESEND_API_KEY/apiKeySecret supplies a named secret. No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Status code only; no private response text in errors. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. No downloads, SMTP, React rendering, listeners, webhook registration, token refresh or API-key creation (no supported secret sink). Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction and official OpenAPI 1.5.1.

definitions.name: Resend Retrieve a single received email
definitions.description: Resend Retrieve a single received email
definitions.documentation: GET /emails/receiving/{email_id}. Only fixed https://api.resend.com. RuntimeConnection has config and credentials.apiKey (accessToken fallback); builtin config.$connection selects it, or RESEND_API_KEY/apiKeySecret supplies a named secret. No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Status code only; no private response text in errors. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. No downloads, SMTP, React rendering, listeners, webhook registration, token refresh or API-key creation (no supported secret sink). Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction and official OpenAPI 1.5.1.

No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Status code only; no private response text in errors. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. definitions.name: Resend Update topics for a contact
definitions.description: Resend Update topics for a contact
definitions.documentation: PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}/topics. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="RESEND CONTACTS/UPDATE-TOPICS". Only fixed https://api.resend.com. RuntimeConnection has config and credentials.apiKey (accessToken fallback); builtin config.$connection selects it, or RESEND_API_KEY/apiKeySecret supplies a named secret. No retries: $retries must be numeric zero. Request body <=512KiB, streamed result <=1MiB, 100-item list bound, whole deadline100–30000ms begins before credential resolution. Status code only; no private response text in errors. Exact known schema fields plus lossless unknown response fields, optional absence/null/falsy and list order preserved; unsafe numbers, duplicate keys and malformed Unicode rejected. Sends and mutations can have irreversible provider effects; uncertainty is never replayed. Batch uses strict all-or-nothing provider validation, <=100 messages, no attachments. Single sends support inline base64 attachment content, never path/URL attachments. Template sends can use stored defaults for sender/subject. One page only; cursors are explicit. No downloads, SMTP, React rendering, listeners, webhook registration, token refresh or API-key creation (no supported secret sink). Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/introduction and official OpenAPI 1.5.1.
